loadRules.gravityTreatment: explicit member self weight; never enable automatic self_weight
loadRules.areaLoadBasis: D and Q per horizontal projected area; W normal pressure per actual strip surface area

equipmentAction.rule: Distribute to the two neighbouring transfer joints by linear distance weights; conserve force and first moment.

liveRevision.scope: Only Q moves. Keep strip geometry, widths, D/W and self weight unchanged.
